podcast.body: Released in late 1985, this single by MC Shan and producer Marley Marl sparked the Bridge Wars. The song "extolled their neighborhood of Queen's Bridge as a mecca for rap," a claim that ignited offense from KRS-One and Boogie Down Productions. "The bridge wars were sparked by a late 1985 single by Queen's rapper MC Shant and producer Marley Marl, called The Bridge, that extolled their neighborhood of Queen's Bridge as a mecca for rap."
